title: Battlement
summary: BAT'TLEMENT, noun [This is said to have been bastillement, from bastille, a fortification.] A wall raised on a building with openings or embrasures, or the embrasure itself.

inlines.v: BAT'TLEMENT, noun [This is said to have been bastillement, from bastille, a fortification.] A wall raised on a building with openings or embrasures, or the embrasure itself.
